item.title: [RG351] 351Files
item.description: 351Files 351Files is a single panel file manager, tailored for Anbernic 351 devices: RG351V and RG351P. It can be easily adapted to any Linux-based device. Based on DinguxCommander. Features Single panel file manager Copy, move, rename, delete, create directories and files. Display file size, compute directory size Text file viewer Text file editor Image viewer (original size or fit screen, next / previous image) Github page : https://github.com/Tardigrade-nx/351Files Releases : https://github.

item.title: [Dingoo] DinguxCommander
item.description: DinguxCommander DinguxCommander is a dual-panel file manager for Dingoo A320 (Dingux). Download: DinguxCommander_v2.1.tar.gz Source: DinguxCommander_v2.1_src.tar.gz Features: Copy, move and delete multiple files. View a file Execute a file Rename a file/dir Create a new directory Display disk space used by a list of selected files/dirs Display disk information (used, available) For more information, see file README.txt.
